items.title: Comment on ‘Assessing the accuracy of the Climate TRACE global vehicular CO2 emissions’
items.title_en: Comment on ‘Assessing the accuracy of the Climate TRACE global vehicular CO2 emissions’
items.title_zh: 对《评估Climate TRACE全球机动车二氧化碳排放数据的准确性》一文的评论
items.summary_en: On-road transportation is a key contributor to greenhouse gas emissions in the US, but detailed spatio-temporal estimates vary among different estimation methods and data sources. Gurney (2026 Environ. Res. Lett.21 094018) compares on-road fossil-fuel CO estimates of the Climate TRACE emissions inventory to those of the Vulcan inventory. They find a 70.4% mean relative difference (MRD) between the inventories’ urban emissions for 2021. We re-run their analysis using updated Climate TRACE data that was publicly available nearly five months before Gurney et al’s submission and find the MRD is 8.6%.
items.summary_zh: 道路运输是美国温室气体排放的主要来源之一，但不同估算方法和数据来源得出的详细时空估算结果存在差异。 Gurney（2026，《环境研究快报》21卷 094018）将Climate TRACE排放清单中关于道路化石燃料二氧化碳的估算值与Vulcan清单中的相关数据进行了比较。 他们发现，这两个清单在2021年城市排放量方面的平均相对差异（MRD）为70.4%。我们使用更新的Climate TRACE数据（该数据在Gurney等人提交论文前近五个月已公开发布）重新进行了分析，发现平均相对差异（MRD）为8.6%。

items.summary_en: A Comment on Gurney et al (2026 Environ. Res. Lett.21 094018); G26) attributes our finding of a 70.4% mean relative difference (MRD) between Climate TRACE (CT) and Vulcan urban on-road CO2 emissions to a since-corrected error in one CT release, reporting an 8.6% MRD using corrected data. We ’s claimed correction date, but set this timing question aside to focus on more substantive concerns. The cited correction is a single multiplicative rescaling that, by construction, can—biases the Comment does ’s own claims of unprecedented spatial granularity. We further show that the national- and county-scale ‘agreement’ the Comment cites is uninformative about the sub-national accuracy G26 actually assessed, since CT’s national totals are explicitly calibrated to EDGAR by construction, while county-level differences remain large and widely dispersed. Vulcan’s own independent validation record—against atmospheric radiocarbon inversion, traffic count, and EPA state-level estimates—su’s recommendation that CT’s on-road emissions estimates be used with caution pending independent, peer-reviewed validation remains fully justified.

items.title: A scoping review of psychosocial factors of climate change inaction: implications for climate change communication and education
items.title_en: A scoping review of psychosocial factors of climate change inaction: implications for climate change communication and education
items.title_zh: 关于气候变化不作为的心理社会因素的范围性综述：对气候变化传播与教育的启示
items.summary_en: Climate change communication and education efforts often focus on the cognitive aspects of addressing climate change, emphasizing that a key path to solving climate change-related challenges may be achieved through an educated public that better understands the science of this issue. However, despite decades of information-heavy communication and education efforts, designed with knowledge-related outcomes in mind, meaningful and sustained action to address climate change has yet to occur at a broad scale. This lack of effective, sustained action has motivated researchers from a range of fields to examine other factors that prevent climate change action. We undertook a systematic scoping review of peer-reviewed, empirical studies (n = 92) focusing on psychological and sociological (psychosocial) factors associated with climate change inaction. Through thematic analysis, we identified trends and patterns across the studies, but also noted that no obvious list of discrete psychosocial factors associated with climate inaction emerged. Political ideology and emotions were the most common factors discussed as influencing climate change inaction. Other psychosocial factors receiving notable attention included climate change perceptions, trust in institutions and leaders, values, and efficacy beliefs. The most-recommended strategies for improving effectiveness of climate change communication and education were attending to climate-related emotions; addressing issues of ideology and trust; and targeting systemic and structural barriers. Findings also emphasize that quality climate communication and education must acknowledge and build on people’s unique relationships with their places, communities, and stories.
items.summary_zh: 气候变化传播与教育工作往往侧重于应对气候变化的认知层面，强调解决气候变化相关挑战的关键途径之一，可能是通过提高公众科学素养，使其更好地理解这一问题的科学原理。 然而，尽管数十年来开展了大量以知识传播为目标、信息密集型的传播与教育工作，但针对气候变化的有意义且持续的行动尚未在广泛范围内实现。这种有效且持续行动的缺失，促使来自多个领域的研究人员开始探讨阻碍气候变化行动的其他因素。 我们对聚焦于与气候变化不作为相关的心理和社会学（心理社会）因素的同行评审实证研究（n = 92）进行了系统性范围综述。 通过主题分析，我们识别出了各研究中的趋势和模式，但也注意到，尚未形成一份与气候不作为相关的、明确的独立心理社会因素清单。 政治意识形态和情绪是被讨论最多的、影响气候变化不作为的因素。其他受到显著关注的社会心理因素包括对气候变化的认知、对机构和领导者的信任、价值观以及效能信念。 为提高气候变化传播与教育成效，最常被推荐的策略包括：关注与气候相关的情绪；解决意识形态和信任问题；以及针对系统性和结构性障碍采取措施。研究结果还强调，高质量的气候传播与教育必须承认并基于人们与其所处环境、社区及个人故事之间的独特联系。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01989-3Producing cellulose nanocrystals conventionally involves hazardous chemicals, complex purification and high energy consumption. items.title: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it
items.title_en: Earth's next ice age may have already begun. Global warming stopped it
items.title_zh: 地球的下一次冰河时代可能已经开始了。全球变暖阻止了它的到来。
items.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered surprising evidence that Earth’s next ice age may have already begun, only to be stopped by global warming. By studying ancient plants preserved beneath the Barnes Ice Cap in the Canadian Arctic, researchers discovered that the remnants of a massive ice sheet began expanding again about 2,000 years ago, signaling the possible start of a new glacial period. But by the 1960s, rising temperatures had reversed that growth, causing the ice to shrink instead.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现了一项令人惊讶的证据，表明地球的下一次冰河时代可能已经开始，但随后被全球变暖所阻止。 通过研究加拿大北极地区巴恩斯冰盖下保存的远古植物，研究人员发现，约2000年前，一块巨大冰盖的残余部分开始再次扩张，这预示着新一轮冰期的可能开始。但到了20世纪60年代，气温上升扭转了这一扩张趋势，导致冰盖反而开始萎缩。
